name: Chemical Product Development and Commercialization
description: This course introduces students to the principles and practices of chemical product design. Unlike traditional process-oriented chemical engineering, this course emphasizes product innovation and the integration of technical, economic, environmental, and societal factors in developing successful chemical products. Students will use real-world tools and case studies, culminating in a group design project.
